quick.topic: Hand off more than the picture
quick.summary: Why the built screen did not match the design, and what a handoff needs.
quick.takeaway: States, behaviour, spacing values and edge cases, not just the picture.

parts.title: Hand off more than the picture

beats.line: The developer built my screen. The spacing is off and errors show raw text. Whose fault?

board.text: Hand off more than the picture

beats.line: Then they guessed the rest. Hand over four things.
Every state, including empty and error.
How things behave. What happens on tap, on failure.
Spacing and colours as named values from the system.
And the edge cases. Long names, no data.
Developers can figure that out, surely?
They can. Each one differently. Then you fix it twice.
Error state, long name case and spacing values are in the file now.
Now the build can match the design the first time.

quiz.question: Which handoff is most likely to be built as designed?
options: Screens for every state, with behaviour notes and named values
One polished picture of the main screen
A verbal walkthrough in a meeting
A link to a similar app
quiz.explanation: Covering states, behaviour and values removes the guesses that cause mismatches.

quiz.question: A single picture of the finished screen tells a developer everything they need.
quiz.explanation: It leaves out states, behaviour and edge cases, which the developer then has to guess.
